question: The sides of a triangle are 34 cm, 88 cm, and 78 cm. What is the length of its altitude corresponding to the side with a length of 88 cm?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Semi-perimeter (s) = (34 + 88 + 78) ÷ 2 = 100 cm.

Area using Heron's formula = √(100 × (100 − 34) × (100 − 88) × (100 − 78))

Area = √(100 × 66 × 12 × 22) = √(100 × 12 × 12 × 121) = 1320 cm²

Height on base 88 cm = (2 × Area) ÷ Base = (2 × 1320) ÷ 88 = 30 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 30 cm.**
